name: Curse These Fat Fingers
summary: In the Searing Gorge, Hansel Heavyhands can no longer deliver beatings as before. Swollen fingers leave Hansel asking you to pound the heavy war golems instead.

sections.title: Fingers Like Sausages
sections.body: Hansel Heavyhands blames the Searing Gorge climate and its thin air for swelling their fingers. They resemble huge Thelsamar blood sausages. With fingers like these, Hansel can no longer deliver beatings as before, so they need you to handle their business.

sections.title: First on the List
sections.body: Hansel wants you to pound the Gorge's heavy war golems hard. Twenty must be destroyed. They roam the areas around the Cauldron, and you return to Hansel once enough have fallen.

aliases: who gives curse these fat fingers
faq.answer: Hansel Heavyhands is in the Searing Gorge, where swollen fingers keep them from fighting. Hansel asks you to do the pounding instead.

faq.q: Why can Hansel not fight the golems personally?
faq.answer: Hansel blames the Searing Gorge climate and thin air for swelling their fingers. They liken them to huge Thelsamar blood sausages.

faq.q: What foes must be dealt with?
faq.answer: You must destroy twenty heavy war golems.

faq.q: Where are the heavy war golems located?
faq.answer: The heavy war golems roam the areas around the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge.

attribution: Classic quest text: Curse These Fat Fingers
